Council Member Kupin moved to adopt the resolution and that all members voting in the affirmative be listed as a cosponsor pursuant to Rule 12.3 of the Rules of Procedure of the Council, which motion was seconded and approved by the following vote:
EventItemTitle: A resolution commending and honoring the life and legacy of Jack Cawthon.

EventItemActionText: Council Member Kupin moved that the bill be deferred to the December 1, 2026 Council meeting, which motion was seconded and approved by a voice vote of the Council.
EventItemTitle: An ordinance approving a greenway participation agreement between the Metropolitan Government of Nashville and Davidson County, acting by and through the Board of Parks and Recreation and Department of Water and Sewerage Services, and Jeff Zeitlin for the construction of certain greenway improvements. (Proposal No. 2026M-056AG-001)

EventItemActionText: Having been unanimously approved by all of the appropriate committees, upon motion duly seconded, all of the items on the Consent Agenda were approved by the following vote: Yes (32): Suara, Porterfield, Evans-Segall, Allen, Hill, Toombs, Cortese, Parker, Capp, Benedict, Harrell, Hancock, Eslick, Evans, Bradford, Huffman, Welsch, Vo, Cash, Kupin, Taylor, Weiner, Druffel, Gadd, Preptit, Nash, Ellis, Sepulveda, Rutherford, Styles, Lee, and Ewing; No (0); Abstain (0).

Council Member Taylor moved that the secondary consent agenda be adopted, which motion was seconded and approved by the following vote: Yes (32): Suara, Porterfield, Evans-Segall, Allen, Hill, Toombs, Cortese, Parker, Capp, Benedict, Harrell, Hancock, Eslick, Evans, Bradford, Huffman, Welsch, Vo, Cash, Kupin, Taylor, Weiner, Druffel, Gadd, Preptit, Nash, Ellis, Sepulveda, Rutherford, Styles, Lee, and Ewing; No (0); Abstain (0).
Council Member Cortese moved that the Resolution be adopted, which motion was seconded and approved by the following roll call vote:
EventItemTitle: A resolution requesting the Metropolitan Nashville Airport Authority to collaborate with the Federal Aviation Administration in consideration of residents affected by changes to air traffic patterns at Nashville International Airport.

EventItemActionText: Council Member Parker moved that the resolution be adopted as substituted, which motion was seconded and approved by the following vote:
EventItemTitle: A resolution approving an amendment to an intergovernmental agreement and two new intergovernmental agreements by and between the Tennessee Department of Transportation (“TDOT”) and the Metropolitan Government, acting by and through the Nashville Department of Transportation and Multimodal Infrastructure (“NDOT”), for roadway and infrastructure improvements to Cowan Street/Marine Drive and James Robertson Parkway. (Proposal No. 2026M-061AG-001 and 2026M-062AG-001).
